# Security Policy

Security fixes apply to the current main branch; historical experiment branches are not supported.

Report vulnerabilities through GitHub private vulnerability reporting. Do not put vulnerability
details, credentials, personal data, or exploit steps in a public Issue or PR.

If private reporting is unavailable, ask a maintainer for a private channel without including
technical details in the public request.

If a secret is committed, rotate or revoke it first. Removing a commit does not invalidate the
credential. Then remove the value from the repository and review affected logs or artifacts.

Use synthetic data for reproduction and test only systems you are authorized to access.
